poc_summary: Objective: Validate Dedicated capacity performance and SLOs for Aurora's mixed workloads. Run controlled load and soak tests on proposed reserved cluster sizing, measure 50/95/99 latencies, throughput ceilings, KV-cache hit improvements, and failure/fallback behavior. Deliver final sizing recommendation, reserved GPU count, and SLA terms for procurement.
poc_requirements: Throughput target: sustained 450 requests/sec for interactive chat during peak (US-EAST) with mixed background jobs
Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end response < 250ms for short-context chat (<= 256 tokens); p99 < 500ms
Soak: 72h continuous mixed workload run with daily rerank batch (100k items) and hourly embedding bursts
Availability target for POC: no more than 1% error rate; graceful degradation via model variant fallback
Isolation: background rerank jobs must not increase chat p95 by >20% when running concurrently
test_plan: Test harness: k6 for HTTP-level load; custom runner for token-level generation to capture per-token latency
Representative prompts: 1) Short chat intent resolution (~40 tokens), 2) Long context summarize (>=512 tokens), 3) Rerank batch slice (top-100), 4) Embedding batch (bulk 10k requests)
Load tests: step-up ramp to peak over 30m, hold peak for 2h, collect percentile metrics and GPU utilization
Soak tests: 72h run with scheduled rerank/embedding batches; monitor memory, GPU memory fragmentation, disk IO for KV cache
Failure scenarios: simulate node preemption, region failover to EU cluster, model variant fallback to quantized variant and measure quality delta
Observability: enable token-level traces, per-route cost breakdown, and tracing hooks for 3 annotated user journeys
pricing_notes: Customer prefers a committed reserved capacity bid. Preliminary sizing: 4xA100-equivalent baseline to meet 450 rps; recommend option to scale to 6 GPUs for predictable peaks. Ask finance for 12-month vs 36-month discount tiers. Customer asked for SLA credits table - include p95 latency targets and throughput guarantees in appendix.
